description: Tuned for dirt sprint cars where steering is done with throttle and rear tire slide. SAT is reduced since front tires aren't doing the work. Rear traction loss, yaw feedback, and throttle-steer are the primary effects.

self_aligning_torque._note: Reduced heavily - front tires on dirt sprint cars provide minimal useful SAT

rear_traction_loss._note: PRIMARY EFFECT - this is how you feel the rear stepping out and how far it's sliding

dirt_yaw_feedback._note: Constant sense of car rotation rate - essential for dirt since you're always sliding

throttle_steer._note: Feel the connection between throttle and rear slide. Key for dirt sprint driving

dirt_surface_rumble._note: Rougher and heavier than pavement rumble - all 4 corners contribute

engine_vibration._note: Sprint car engines run high RPM, adds immersion

suspension._note: Reduced - less useful on dirt since weight transfer is constant in the slide

curb_rumble._note: Disabled - no curbs on dirt tracks, dirt_surface_rumble replaces this

tire_slip._note: Disabled - front tire slip effect replaced by rear_traction_loss for dirt
